title: Speaker Meeting Olampian Anjali Bhagwat
summary: Anjali Bhagwat’s name is synonymous with excellence, discipline, determination, and sporting leadership.
description: Anjali Bhagwat’s name is synonymous with excellence, discipline, determination, and sporting leadership. With an illustrious career spanning nearly four decades, she has not only brought glory to India through her achievements on the shooting range but has also played a significant role in shaping the future of Indian shooting. Her journey began with five years of training in the NCC and Civil Defence, where discipline became the foundation of her sporting career. In 1988, at her very first National Championship, she won a silver medal — marking the beginning of an extraordinary journey. Anjali went on to become National Champion 11 times, setting nine national records. Her national career includes an extraordinary haul of 78 gold, 44 silver and 21 bronze medals. Her international journey began in 1995 and soon established her among the world's finest shooters.
